create_slab_from_bulk_random: create a Slab object by randomly sampling a slab from a Bulk object with max miller index
generate_all_slabs_for_bulk: generate all symmetrically distinct slabs for a bulk structure up to a given max miller index
compute_slabs_with_millers: compute slabs for specific miller indices from a bulk structure using the compute_slabs function
tag_surface_atoms_on_slab: tag surface atoms on a slab structure using Voronoi coordination and height-based heuristics
tile_and_constrain_slab_atoms: tile slab atoms to minimum dimensions and set fixed constraints on sub-surface bulk atoms
